data.name: Itee
data.gender_notes: Itee is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Itee is a Sanskrit name derived from the goddess Ishani, the goddess of motherhood and fertility. In Hindu mythology, Ishani is often depicted as a nurturing mother, holding her child in her arms. This name is believed to bring blessings of a healthy and happy child to new parents. The name Itee carries the meaning “Goddess of Motherhood” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Itee usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of motherhood and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the divine qualities of love, nurturing, and motherhood.
data.etymology: Itee belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of Motherhood.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Itee total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
